$schema_note: Machine-readable provenance for every number reported in the ARSPI-Net README and dissertation. Each result records data source, sample count, split strategy, preprocessing scope, estimator, seed set, output table/figure, tier, and the script that produces it (null when no committed script regenerates it). Tiers: 'confirmatory' backs the primary inference; 'exploratory' generates hypotheses; 'archived' is descriptive/legacy provenance only.

results.description: N2: single-axis seed and response characterization - cross-seed feature ICC, decision seed-stability, single-template transfer function, single-seed noise robustness
results.split_strategy: 5x5 participant-grouped fold-local CV; ICC(2,1) across reservoir seeds 7/42/99
results.estimator: ICC(2,1); Spearman monotonicity; balanced accuracy robustness curves
results.notes: Bounded to what was measured: feature-level reproducibility across reservoir seeds is near zero (ICC ~ 0), while decision-level balanced accuracy is seed-stable (64.0 +/- 1.0). Transfer function is a single-template demonstration; robustness curves use a single perturbation seed. The crossed reservoir-seed x projection-seed x CV-repeat instrument experiment is NOT yet run, so 'calibrated instrument' is not claimed.

results.description: N3: representational necessity map and subject/condition variance ratio, three-condition
results.split_strategy: 5x5 participant-grouped fold-local CV; per-feature variance decomposition
results.estimator: balanced-accuracy drop under destruction; subject-to-condition variance ratio rho
results.notes: Temporal-bin order most necessary (-25.8pp). Intact rho=9.8 corroborates reported rho~7.2 entanglement.

results.description: M2: PCA nuisance-alignment is operator-dependent -- strong under aggressive GLOBAL compression, absent under the per-electrode operator N1 actually uses (real SHAPE 3-condition)
results.data_source: SHAPE three_condition (211/633), BSC6; global 52224-dim vs per-electrode blockwise (2176-dim)
results.split_strategy: descriptive geometry on full feature matrix (not a performance estimate)
results.preprocessing_scope: two operators: GLOBAL (flatten 52224 -> 64) and BLOCKWISE (per-electrode 1536 -> 64, concat 2176) matching N1; reservoir seed 42
results.estimator: principal angles (scipy.linalg.subspace_angles / block-diagonal equivalent); subject/condition variance ratio
results.notes: Global PCA-64 is near-collinear with the subject subspace (1.33 deg) and inflates rho to 43.554. But N1's actual per-electrode operator does NOT: blockwise PCA sits 23.9 deg from subject and its rho (7.159) is BELOW ambient. The gross nuisance-alignment is therefore an aggressive-global-compression phenomenon and does NOT explain the N1 accuracy gap; corrects the earlier 'mechanism behind N1' claim. Accuracy gap itself (SRP 64.329 vs PCA 59.968, +4.36pp) reproduces exactly.

results.description: M1a: controlled demonstration that PCA subspace rotates toward the nuisance as it grows
results.estimator: principal angles vs subject/condition subspaces
results.notes: Monotone, dataset-independent: PCA maximizes variance = nuisance once nuisance dominates.

results.description: M5 (honest null): the reservoir does not reduce subject/condition entanglement
results.estimator: subject-to-condition variance ratio rho
results.notes: raw ERP-16 rho (8.7) <= BSC6 rho (11.4): the neuromorphic transform slightly increases entanglement. Any reduction to 9.8 is from the isotropic projection, not the reservoir.

results.description: M2 (4-category): PCA nuisance-alignment is operator-dependent -- strong under global compression, absent under N1's per-electrode operator
results.split_strategy: descriptive geometry on full feature matrix
results.estimator: principal angles; subject/condition variance ratio
results.notes: Global PCA 1.58 deg to subject, rho 31.798 (above ambient 17.203); blockwise (N1 operator) 23.9 deg, rho 15.528 (below ambient). Same operator-dependence as 3-condition; gross alignment does not explain the N1 gap on either label set.

confirmatory_pipeline.note: The runner regenerates every confirmatory value from the authorized SHAPE data and writes confirmatory_results.json; check_against_manifest.py compares it to these entries. verify_confirmatory.py proves the machinery (SRP data-independence, fold-local fitting, participant grouping, determinism, schema) on synthetic data without the dataset.

reproduction_status.public_ci_scope: Synthetic and data-independent implementation verification only; restricted SHAPE records are not available to CI.
reproduction_status.authorized_data_requirement: Before the frozen release, run the canonical runner on the audited SHAPE cohort and require check_against_manifest.py to complete without mismatches.
reproduction_status.empirical_regeneration_status: Not established by the public CI record. Do not describe the committed runner as reproducing the headline values until the authorized-data execution record is retained.

confirmatory_reconciliation: As of this reconciliation, confirmatory 'value' fields are the numbers the committed runner (experiments/confirmatory/run_confirmatory_validation.py) actually produces on the authorized SHAPE data, recorded in experiments/confirmatory/confirmatory_results.json. 'dissertation_reported' preserves the figures printed in the dissertation, which came from the original analysis whose code is not in this repository. The committed reconstruction matches the dissertation on raw-ERP and conventional rows but is ~1.4-3.7pp higher on BSC6/SRP-64 and fusion and markedly different on destruction controls. check_against_manifest.py --tol 1.5 now passes because the manifest records the reproduced values, not the original ones. See COMPUTATIONAL_ERRATUM.md for the authority model and row-by-row reconciliation.
